newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Marlin expects to pay dividend in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Marlin expects to pay dividend in 1997.

text.p: South African granite producer Marlin Corp Ltd expects improved results in 1997 and said a dividend should be declared after it was passed in 1996.

Managing director Graham Treagus said 1997 would be a year of rationalisation following acquisitions including a 71.4 percent stake in Minaco Granite and Marble Ltd from January 1, 1996, and 56.2 percent of Kudu Granite Holdings Ltd from January 1, 1997.
Treagus said an announcement regarding rationalisation of the three quoted companies would be made shortly.

"It is expected that the acquisition of Kudu and the effects of rationalisation will have a positive influence on the group's results during the current financial year, and we anticipate that a dividend will be declared at the end of this year," Treagus said.
He added that difficulties experienced in the beneficiation divisions, where losses amounting to six million rand (including finance charges) had negatively impacted on results, were being addressed.
